messages.subject: Shiny App works locally, but does not run properly on shinyapps.io
parts:

I have deployed an app on shinyapps.io which includes a download button to download a data frame in PDF format (using rmarkdown and knitr libraries).

I have used https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/generating-reports.html as a reference to build this functionality into the app.

When I run the app on my local machine, it works properly allowing me to download the reports. However, when I'm deploying the app on shinyapps.io, the download feature does not work as expected.
